title: D3.js
summary: Calm paper diagrams for everyday subjects: arch bars, a soft trend line, donut, before-and-after, a seasons wheel and breathing bubbles; planners (habit week, routine, checklist, calendar) and comparisons (star ratings, prices). They fade up, grow and draw on softly, with handwritten notes in the accent colour, then keep drifting. Use them full-screen as cutaways, or pass "clear": true to float the card as a paper sheet over footage.
usage: {"piece": "d3/bar-chart", "props": {"title": "…", "unit": "…", "items": […], "accent": "leaf"}}. accent: leaf, clay, teal or sun. Sample data is illustrative. Files: library/themes/lifestyle/d3/pieces/ (_local.js holds two shared motion helpers, not a piece).

items.name: Bar chart
items.description: Arch-topped bars grow from a hairline; the tallest takes the accent and a handwritten note with an arrow.

items.name: Line chart
items.description: One soft line draws across a faint colour wash, dots land as it passes and a note points at the peak.

items.name: Donut
items.description: A ring sweeps round in soft colours with a big number in the middle and a legend beside it: a day, a budget, a plate.

items.name: Before and after
items.description: Two columns joined by lines that draw across; what rose takes the accent, what fell stays quiet.

items.name: Seasons wheel
items.description: The year as a ring of twelve leaves, each grown to its month's value and coloured by season.

items.name: Soft bubbles
items.description: Breathing blobs sized by value and packed together: what is in the bag, the bowl or the budget.

items.name: Habit tracker
items.description: A week of habits: done days fill and tick one after another, missed days stay open, each row totals up.

items.name: Routine timeline
items.description: A routine down one line: heavy times on the left, steps on the right, a handwritten aside on the one that matters.

items.name: Checklist progress
items.description: Steps tick themselves off while a progress bar fills and a big count keeps up. `times` ticks each on its word.

items.name: Calendar month
items.description: A month at a glance: marked days fill in, a run of days joins into one soft pill and a note points at it.

items.name: Star ratings
items.description: Scores out of five as rows of stars that fill to the exact score; the best row takes the accent.

items.name: Price compare
items.description: Three options as paper slips with heavy prices and ticked points; the recommended one is inked dark and tagged.
